catalogue.name: Solids centrifuge
catalogue.line: spins the solids, cells first, out of the broth: each component splits between a solids-rich cake and the liquid

insOuts.name: feed
insOuts.what: the stream from the unit before

insOuts.name: cake

notes: Spins the solids, cells first, out of the broth: each component splits between a solids-rich cake and the liquid.
Needs split: BioSTEAM requires the split.
Not offered: order, the order a split's shares are listed in: the per-component keys name each chemical instead.

Not offered: solids, which chemicals count as solids, a list of names, which a parameter of one number or one word cannot hold: BioSTEAM takes every chemical locked as a solid, and sizes the centrifuges by their load.
Not offered: moisture_ID, the chemical the moisture content is of: BioSTEAM's water when unset, and a broth's moisture is water.
Not offered: strict_moisture_content, a check switch: whether BioSTEAM refuses a cake that cannot hold the moisture asked; left to the class.
The liquid goes on by default, as it does for a product in solution; a train routes the cake on for a product held in the cells.
The moisture content sets the water: BioSTEAM moves water between the outlets to meet it and never reads a split of water, so split.Water is not read while a moisture content is set (§5.R).
split is one key here, expanded per component as <key>.<item> when a train's unit is resolved (§5.2); records bind by the train's product then.
No evidence pool here (no corpus exported), so no record binds.
